initial_requirements: USDA Agricultural Research Service needs a centralized system for watershed research data that is currently managed separately at individual sites. Watershed staff should upload and maintain standardized water, soil, land-management, conservation, and economic data, while researchers and approved public users can search, analyze, visualize, download, and report integrated datasets. Access must reflect the responsibilities and confidentiality limits of different user groups.

turns.interviewer_utterance: Could you describe the different user roles that need access to the watershed data system, and for each role, what they are allowed to do or not do in terms of uploading, maintaining, searching, analyzing, visualizing, downloading, and viewing confidential data?
turns.interviewee_utterance: At a high level, we have watershed staff, researchers, approved public users, and system administrators. Watershed staff would be the main data stewards, so they can upload and maintain the standardized datasets for their sites, and they can also search, analyze, visualize, and download the data they’re responsible for, including confidential data if it’s within their role. Researchers would generally be able to search, analyze, visualize, and download approved datasets, but they should not be able to upload or directly edit the official records unless they have been granted site-specific stewardship rights. Approved public users would be limited to searching, viewing, and possibly downloading nonconfidential or released datasets, but they should not see restricted data or make changes. System administrators would manage accounts, permissions, and system configuration, but they should not normally alter the scientific data itself unless they also have a watershed staff role.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Create a centralized watershed research data system for USDA ARS to replace separately managed site-level data, enabling standardized data upload, maintenance, search, analysis, visualization, download, and reporting across integrated datasets.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Watershed staff, researchers, approved public users, and system administrators. Watershed staff act as data stewards for site data. Researchers access approved datasets for analysis and related use. Approved public users have limited access to nonconfidential/released information. System administrators manage accounts, permissions, and system configuration.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Support uploading and maintenance of standardized watershed datasets; searching, analyzing, visualizing, downloading, and reporting integrated data; user access control by role; account and permission management; and restricted access to confidential or released data based on authorization.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: Watershed staff may upload and maintain official site datasets and access confidential data within their role. Researchers may search, analyze, visualize, and download approved datasets but cannot upload or directly edit official records unless granted site-specific stewardship rights. Approved public users may only search, view, and possibly download nonconfidential or released datasets. System administrators manage accounts, permissions, and configuration but normally do not alter scientific data unless they also have watershed staff privileges.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Standardized watershed research datasets including water, soil, land-management, conservation, and economic data; integrated datasets; site-level watershed records; confidential data; nonconfidential/released datasets; user accounts and permission records.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Access must reflect user responsibilities and confidentiality limits. Official scientific data changes are restricted to authorized watershed staff or users with site-specific stewardship rights. Public users cannot access restricted data. Administrators generally cannot modify scientific data unless also authorized as watershed staff.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: Researchers may be granted site-specific stewardship rights that allow uploading or editing official records. Approved public users may be allowed to download only nonconfidential or released datasets. System administrators can alter scientific data only if they also hold watershed staff role privileges.
